The '''1997 Supercopa de España''' was a two-leg [[Football in Spain|Spanish]] [[Association football|football]] match played on 20 August and 23 August 1997. The contestants were Barcelona, who were Spanish Cup winners in [[1996–97 Copa del Rey|1996–97]], and Real Madrid, who won the [[1996–97 La Liga|1996–97]] Spanish League. Real Madrid won 5&ndash;3 on aggregate.
